title: HERF Coolidor Product Review #cigarshow #herf #coolidor #humidor
description:
Coo·li·dor
/ko͞oliˌdôr/
noun
a cooler that has been modified to store fine cigars and tobacco at the desired relative humidity
No need to create your own coolidor with the new HERF coolidor with its 3 custom cedar trays.
Dimensions: 19 ½” L x 25 11/16” W x 14 3/8” H
Capacity 450
Finish Black
Material Acrylic
Style Desktop
The HERF Cool-a-Dor holds up to 450 cigars inside durable acrylic material utilizing three levels of mahogany drawers specifically deigned to be stackable. It also features metal latches to lock it down, dedicated spaces to fit your humidification, and indented lid to set your next Cool-a-Dor on top (if you dare). Start growing your cigar collection like a champion!

Enjoy the leaf, grow the culture.
